# The person's answers in the CV proxy run

The person playing Giulia Placeholder (fictional) answers each question the
agent asks with the matching answer below, word for word. A question with no
matching answer gets "skip".

- Language: Italian, please.
- Links / email: giulia@example.com is the one to show.
- Anything else already in the CV: "It's all in the CV."
- Is the content right (read-back): "Yes, looks good."
